About the Role

Hinge Health values design as a strategic partner in shaping product direction and member experience. As a Staff Product Designer on the Outcomes Pod, you will focus on helping people understand, log, and act on their progress over time. At the Staff level, you will lead large ambiguous problem spaces, shape product vision and strategy with partners, and align senior leaders around a clear design point of view. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and other cross-functional teammates to turn complex, data-rich, emotionally sensitive moments into simple and motivating experiences. We are looking for a designer with strong UI/UX craft, deep product thinking, and the ability to simplify complex clinical data into comprehensible member-facing insights. This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to shape how Hinge Health helps members see progress, stay engaged, and build confidence in their care journey. Hinge Health is building a new healthcare system, one built around the person, with a mission to revolutionize the treatment and prevention of pain and help move people beyond pain. This position provides a unique opportunity to drive high-impact outcomes during a transformative phase of growth. As we scale with 51% year-over-year revenue gains and a member base expanding by over 47% annually, your leadership will be instrumental in sustaining our momentum and shaping the future of digital care.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Lead the design vision and strategy for the Outcomes pod’s member-facing experiences, with primary focus on the Progress tab, pain logging, and the broader story members see about their improvement over time.

  • Improve how and when members share pain data and create useful feedback loops.

  • Translate complex clinical and behavioral data into simple, motivating interfaces that help members understand trends, next best actions, and the value of staying engaged.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to define hypotheses, run experiments, and use qualitative and quantitative signals to improve member experience and outcomes.

  • Raise the quality bar across the pod by creating frameworks, patterns, and design principles that make the work more coherent and scalable over time.

  • Influence adjacent teams when shared surfaces, shared metrics, or shared behaviors affect outcomes-related experiences.

  • Champion accessibility, clarity, and product quality so members with different needs, contexts, and motivation levels can succeed.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of product design experience, including close partnership with product and engineering teams.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Interaction, Industrial, Product, or Service Design,

    Human-Computer Interaction, Architecture, or equivalent experience.

  • Expertise in interaction and visual design, with a track record of advancing craft quality across teams.

  • Experience leading ambiguous problem spaces, setting vision, and defining design strategy across products or platforms.

  • Strong fluency in data-informed design, including forming hypotheses, partnering on experiments, facilitating research, and translating insights into action.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders around design direction.

  • Demonstrated success mentoring other designers and elevating the quality and impact of team output.

  • Strong prototyping and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to create cohesive experiences across flows, components, and product surfaces.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product design experience, including close partnership with product and engineering teams.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Interaction, Industrial, Product, or Service Design

  • Experience designing progress tracking, dashboards, data visualization, or other data-rich product experiences.

  • Experience simplifying complex systems into intuitive consumer-facing experiences, especially in health, wellness, or habit-forming product spaces.

  • Proven facilitation skills and comfort leading leadership conversations on large,ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Experience contributing to or shaping design systems that scale quality and consistency across products.

  • Curiosity about emerging AI tools and workflows, and thoughtful judgment about where they can improve design quality or speed.

  • Passion for helping people live healthier lives through thoughtful design and technology.

About Hinge Health


Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more athttp://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), allowing you to acquire company stock via payroll at a 15% discount against the lower market price.

  • Comprehensive and inclusive medical coverage and benefit programs for you and your dependents.

  • Flexible retirement savings through Traditional or Roth 401(k) investment paths.

  • Dedicated lifestyle stipends designed to fuel your professional growth and continuous learning.

Culture and Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

  • Strong prototyping and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to create cohesive experiences across flows, components, and product surfaces.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product design experience, including close partnership with product and engineering teams.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Interaction, Industrial, Product, or Service Design

  • Experience designing progress tracking, dashboards, data visualization, or other data-rich product experiences.

  • Experience simplifying complex systems into intuitive consumer-facing experiences, especially in health, wellness, or habit-forming product spaces.

  • Proven facilitation skills and comfort leading leadership conversations on large,ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Experience contributing to or shaping design systems that scale quality and consistency across products.

  • Curiosity about emerging AI tools and workflows, and thoughtful judgment about where they can improve design quality or speed.

  • Passion for helping people live healthier lives through thoughtful design and technology.

About Hinge Health


Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

What You'll Love About Us

Culture and Engagement

inferact-founding-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Founding Product Designer to give Inferact and vLLM a distinct visual identity, sharp brand presence, and highly intuitive developer product experiences. This is a 0-to-1, full-stack design role for a creator with high aesthetic taste, deep technical curiosity, and an AI-native way of executing.

You will bridge the gap between technical infrastructure and visual craft. In your first 90 days, you’ll establish our visual language across high-visibility social assets, model launch campaigns, blog graphics, and partner announcements. As we scale, you’ll transition into shaping our web surfaces, brand identity, internal tooling, and core product interfaces. You’ll work directly with founders, engineering leads, product, and marketing to build design systems that scale across open-source communities, developer tools, and enterprise platforms.

30-60-90 Day Milestones

  • 30 Days: Own and ship high-impact design assets for model launches, technical content, and ecosystem news. You’ll onboard to the inference ecosystem by establishing a baseline visual language for Inferact and vLLM.

  • 60 Days: Expand into initial UI/UX designs for our production tooling and developer dashboards, while continuing to increase your design footprint across our core website, interactive developer pages, partner announcement assets, and i.

  • 90 Days: Own the core design for our enterprise product: focus on core product design—refining UI/UX for developer tools, optimizing developer workflows, and establishing a unified design system from brand assets to product components.

Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Product Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, Interactive Media, or a related field.

  • A strong portfolio or tech-forward personal website demonstrating exceptional craft, strong typography, layout, visual systems, and interactive UI/UX thinking.

  • AI-native operating style, using modern AI image, design, and code generators to explore concepts rapidly and ship production-ready assets.

  • High technical taste and fluency, with a track record of designing for developers, technical products, or complex systems.

  • End-to-end execution capability—able to take a rough idea or technical blog post and independently produce polished visuals, landing pages, or product mockups without needing prescribed steps.

  • Ability to collaborate credibly with technical founders, engineers, and product managers in a fast-paced, high-urgency startup environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing for developer tools, AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, open-source communities, or technical SaaS products.

  • Strong background in visual design, brand systems, illustration, or graphic assets alongside digital product design (UI/UX).

  • Proficiency with modern web design and front-end prototyping tools (Figma, Framer, Webflow, React/Tailwind code prototypes).

  • Experience designing graphics and collateral for major developer conferences, community events, and launch campaigns.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Rive, Lottie) or lightweight 3D design experience (Blender, Cinema 4D, Spline).

  • Built and maintained a personal tech-forward website or creative engineering projects showcasing custom interaction design.

  • Created 0-to-1 visual identities or design systems for a high-growth startup or prominent open-source project.

Logistics

Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California. Will consider remote in the US for exceptional candidates.

Compensation: Compensation is to be determined based on background, skills, and experience. Offers include equity.

Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.

ivo-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Why Join Ivo?

Every civilization runs on the same infrastructure: agreements between people who don't fully trust each other. Sumerians pressed them into clay. Romans carved them into stone. We bury them in 80-page PDFs.

The way those agreements are reviewed hasn't changed in four thousand years — a human reads the whole thing and tries not to miss anything. We're building the AI that finally changes that. Ivo is the contract intelligence platform of choice for companies like Uber, Meta, Canva, IBM, and Shopify. We recently raised our Series B and have grown 800% over the last 12 months.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional designer to join our team in San Francisco. You will guide the vision, strategy, and execution of Ivo’s design system while managing a small team of designers. You will work across Product and Engineering to build a system that elevates product teams, one that enables rapid iteration without sacrificing coherence, taste, or craft.

What You’ll Do

  • Create, maintain, and scale component libraries, design tokens, interaction patterns, and accessibility standards

  • Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ivo’s design system.

  • Partner closely with Engineering to ensure system adoption, alignment, and implementation quality of the design system

  • Develop workflows that improve designer and developer collaboration, such as Figma libraries, documentation, and quality checks

  • Shape internal best practices for design documentation, guidelines, and cross-team collaboration

  • Constantly raise the bar for design craft and execution

What You'll Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in product design

  • Experience building design systems for SaaS platforms

  • Deep expertise in Figma, component libraries, tokens, variants, and systematic file organization

  • Constantly learning and adapting to the rapid changes AI brings to UI/UX

  • A proclivity to adopting and experimenting intelligently with AI tools

  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate system rationale and implementation guidance

  • Experience operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities and high expectations for craft

  • A portfolio that demonstrates how you’ve shaped scalable design patterns, systematized complex UI challenges, and delivered cohesive experiences

Ivo might be a good fit for you if you:

  • Would describe yourself as being relentlessly resourceful.

  • You have a strong internal sense of urgency. You have a bias towards doing things today, rather than tomorrow.

  • Experience working in a startup environment is preferred but not required.

  • Are excited about the adventure of building a company!

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Final offer details are determined based on experience, expertise, and overall fit.

  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in a company that's scaling fast

  • Relocation and Visa Support: We also offer relocation assistance for successful applicants moving to SF, as well as support for visa and green card applications where applicable.

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to suit the needs of you and your family.

  • Flexible Spending & Insurance: Access to HSA and FSA accounts, plus life insurance coverage.

  • 401(k) Program: Save for the future with our 401(k) program.

  • Commuter Benefits: We help make getting to and from the office easier and more convenient.

  • Unlimited PTO: So you can take the time you need to recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work.

  • Office Perks: Enjoy a vibrant Downtown San Francisco office with catered lunch five days a week, premium snacks and coffee, an in-building gym, and a dog-friendly environment.

FAQ

  • What stage of growth is Ivo at?: We launched in early access in 2023. Since then, we’ve had an incredible response from the market and are growing rapidly. We 6x'd in ARR in the last 12 months. Our clients include companies like Uber, Reddit, IBM, Canva, Pinterest, DoorDash, and more. We're happy to share more details with candidates who go through our interview process.

  • Is this a chill gig?: Startups are very hard, especially if they’re growing fast. You’ll have a ton of responsibility, and there’s always an enormous amount of stuff to do. It’s hard work but the payoff is uncapped.

Ivo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jeeves-senior-designer.descriptionHtml:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves.

Location : This role is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE

What You’ll Do:

  • Product Design

    • Design across the full Jeeves platform, from mobile to desktop, with a focus on our core card, payments, and spend management flows

    • Own projects end to end: framing the problem, exploring solutions, shipping with engineering, and measuring outcomes

    • Elevate the craft and consistency of the core product experience — identify UX debt and drive a plan to pay it down

    • Promote the product vision through design exploration, documentation, and presentations to leadership

    • Use AI tools throughout your workflow — generative exploration, AI prototyping, and LLM-assisted copy and documentation — to test more directions faster without sacrificing craft

    • Apply payments and fintech domain expertise to design for real-world financial complexity, including AI-powered product experiences within Jeeves (intelligent expense review, automation, insights)

      • Design Systems

      • Use and extend Jeeves’s existing design system and standards

      • Identify gaps and inconsistencies across product surfaces — using AI tooling to audit at scale — and drive systematic fixes

      • Establish design principles and patterns that other designers and engineers can build on, including patterns for AI-driven features (confidence, explainability, human review)

        • Research & Validation

        • Plan and run your own research — including personally recruiting participants when needed

        • Use AI to accelerate research synthesis and analysis — while keeping human judgment on what customers actually need

        • Validate design decisions with customers before and after shipping

        • Advocate the customer perspective across Jeeves, grounded in evidence

          • Cross-Functional Collaboration

          • Partner daily with product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and product marketers

          • Create and collaborate on the product vision with core product leadership, reporting directly into it

          • Influence design practices and team operations within a distributed, global team — including how the design team adopts AI in its workflows

          • Participate in cross-functional interviews and help raise the design bar in hiring

Minimum Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional product design experience, with senior-level scope on multiple high-impact projects you were directly responsible for

    • Experience designing for fintech, payments, or financial services products

    • A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership: problem framing, exploration, shipped outcomes — not just final screens

    • Demonstrated ability to drive projects forward independently in ambiguous environments, without heavy direction

    • Working fluency with AI tools in your design process — demonstrated by how you actually use them today for exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or documentation (be ready to show this, not just name tools)

    • Experience working within and improving design systems at scale

    • Hands-on research experience, including recruiting your own participants and synthesizing findings into design decisions

    • Track record of close collaboration with PM and Engineering through to shipped product

    • Professional working proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — networks, issuers, partners, and how platforms like Jeeves differentiate within it

    • Experience designing for B2B or finance-team users (controllers, CFOs, ops teams)

    • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences — copilots, agents, or intelligent automation — especially patterns for trust, explainability, and human oversight in financial products

    • Experience working in a globally distributed product organization across time zones

    • Experience mentoring other designers or shaping design team practices

    • Native or professional English and Spanish, Portuguese preferred

jinba-founding-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
Design engineer who owns the full visual and interactive experience of Jinba's platform. You'll build our design system from the ground up, create motion that makes complex workflows feel intuitive, and ship production code alongside the engineering team. This is a founding design role for someone who wants to shape how enterprise users interact with AI-native software.

jito-foundation-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
JTX is our trading app, and it runs on the fastest market infrastructure on Solana, which we also built. It’s live today, self-custodial, and native mobile apps are in development.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to focus mainly on JTX, but you’ll also have the chance to help with other Jito products as needed.

We’re a small team and have already found product-market fit. This shapes the way we work:

  • You’ll make real decisions, not just work through a backlog set by others.

  • We release features and learn from real user feedback, rather than getting stuck in endless debates.

  • Attention to detail is essential here. For a trading product, the small things make all the difference.

About the Position

You’ll work on UX and UI for both web and native mobile. Right now, our main challenge is making JTX feel clear and trustworthy at a glance, not just functional. You’ll also help keep things consistent between web and mobile, and pitch in on marketing design when needed.

You’ll work closely with engineering and product to make the most important decisions. If you’ve ever thought about how traders read a screen under pressure and want to create the product layer that makes speed tangible, this could be the right fit for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Design for JTX across web and mobile, including order entry, market data, charts, positions, execution visibility, onboarding, and wallet flows.

  • Take features from defining the problem through UX and final UI.

  • Own and improve the design system and token library that our engineers use.

  • Help with marketing design when needed, like landing pages, social assets, and launch materials.

  • Jump in on design work for other Jito products when the team needs extra help.

  • Release, observe real usage, and keep improving.

Requirements

  • Strong product sense: you can explain why a decision is right, not just that it looks good.

  • You can spot issues with hierarchy and clarity on a busy screen and explain what’s causing them.

  • You’re comfortable working across research, UX, and UI, just like any early-stage product designer needs to.

  • You can work independently and bring the team in on important decisions, but not every single one.

  • You’re a true collaborator who communicates proactively and works well with engineering and product.

  • You’re comfortable giving direct feedback on others’ work and receiving it on your own. Here, critique is quick and specific, never personal.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and comfortable working directly with token-based design systems.

Preferred (not required)

  • Experience designing consumer (B2C) crypto or fintech products, or hands-on experience as a trader.

  • Trading terminals, exchange or brokerage products.

  • Consumer fintech apps at scale.

  • Data-dense or real-time interfaces, such as dashboards, analytics, or live data visualization.

  • Self-custodial wallets, Solana or EVM products.

  • Experience building or maintaining a token-based design system.

jump-sr-ux-designer.descriptionHtml:
We’re Jump, the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors.

If you're a product designer who has great instincts for customer-focused UX; a desire to talk directly with customers often; experience working from and contributing to a design system; a natural ability to prioritize designing what is crucial over all else—we want to meet you!

About You and Your Role at Jump:

Experience: You have 4–8 years of experience designing software applications for web and mobile. You must be able to contribute directly to the product and design in collaboration with your PM for a primary feature area.

Design abilities: You can design beautiful, intuitive experiences*.* You’re open to feedback, and you can create flows that guide users intuitively through their tasks while accounting for micro-interactions along the way. You’re keeping up with the rapid changes in design processes made possible by AI tools.

Speed, & intuition: We move quickly as a product organization, so you should have an instinct for what makes a feature worth designing (i.e., customers need it) and what the minimum is to ship a quality experience.

Design System & UX Patterns: You're familiar with and respect design systems. We want consistency across the entire app experience so you must be able to understand and use our existing design system and patterns, and feel comfortable proposing adjustments when needed.

Mindset & Philosophy (Why you might want to work with us)

  • We’re a small and efficient design team. Expect meaningful ownership in your areas, and cross-app collaboration.

  • Product demand is extremely high, and our company is growing rapidly. You’ll get to spend time building features you already know customers are desperate for.

    • Raised a $20M series-A in 2025

    • Raised a $80M series-B in 2026

  • Sales, Customer Success, Finance, People, etc orgs are friendly, excited, dedicated, and closely knit. You’ll work with impressive people every day who are kind and invested in Jump’s success.

Compensation/ Benefits

  • $120k-$180k salary depending on experience.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision insurance.

  • Disability, life, indemnity, etc.

  • 401k

  • HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, Commuter

  • Flexible PTO

  • Based in Draper, Utah.

  • Remote or hybrid (must reside in the USA). We’d love to have you fly in occasionally to get to know you.

  • Home Office Setup Stipend

Interview Process:

Finding the ideal fit for a role is an art, so we like to keep the process flexible as we get to know you, and you get to know us. But here are some steps you can more or less count on:

  • We screen aggressively on portfolio sites/case studies and résumés. This is the first, and possibly most important moment to show your visual design abilities.

  • 30–45 minute design review. We’ll spend time understanding how you make decisions, how you respond to feedback, and how you collaborate with PM/engineering partners.

  • A paid trial week (at your standard contracting rate) where you will be paired with a product manager and engineer on a needed feature, check in daily, and collaborate with the rest of the design team.

    • This is as much about you getting a sense of fit as it is us.

    • Availability during normal work hours is important (the closer to 40 hours, the better we’ll be able to get a feel for working together), but we know schedules vary widely. We’ll work with you to make a plan.

Location

Remote (U.S. based)

Employment type

Full time

Department

Product

Compensation

$120k–$180k | Offers equity

juniper-square-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Senior Product Designer to join our team, embedded within a core product squad with broad scope across our platform. This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you will own the end-to-end user experience for your product area, drive meaningful contributions to our design system, and partner closely with product managers and engineers to ship work that makes a real difference for our customers.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation. Designers at this level should be comfortable across the full range of modern design tools, including AI. That might mean starting in an LLM to frame a problem, building a quick prototype in Cursor or Claude Code to explore an interaction, or going to Figma to produce a polished developer reference. The expectation is sound judgment about what will get to the best outcome for the customer and the team.

What you'll do

Own the Work End to End Produce work in whatever form best serves the team and engineering, whether that's annotated flows, coded prototypes, LLM-generated specs with design system context loaded, or Figma files when a polished developer reference is needed. When handing off to engineering, ensure files are complete, accurate, and consistent with our design system. The starting point matters less than the outcome: your output should reflect the kind of judgment and taste that distinguishes considered design from generated templates.

Simplify Complexity Take on hard problems in your product domain and deliver solutions that feel simple. Our users work with sophisticated financial data and workflows. The complexity lives in the craft, not the interface.

Design for AI-Driven Features Contribute to the UX of AI-powered capabilities across our product suite, including proactive recommendations, generative summaries, and predictive insights. Get the trust and transparency details right so these features feel reliable to enterprise customers, not like a black box.

Generate and Apply Insights Conduct research and interpret product analytics to uncover real user needs and measure the impact of your designs. Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and treat research as a velocity tool rather than a gate.

Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to align on strategy and ensure design execution serves both the business and the user. Own the design relationship with your product area end to end.

Strengthen the Design System Continuously improve and expand our design system, advocating for consistency and pattern reuse across the product suite. Collaborate with peers on the design team to give and receive feedback, raising the collective craft of the organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer, with a meaningful portfolio of shipped work across the full development lifecycle.

  • Proven experience designing for a complex B2B or Enterprise SaaS product, ideally in a data-heavy domain.

  • Fluency with modern design and prototyping tools. Figma proficiency is expected, including experience with component libraries, auto-layout, and developer-ready handoff files. Comfort with AI-powered tools (LLMs, Cursor, Claude Code) is equally important, even if you are not writing production code.

  • Experience designing for AI/ML-driven features with strong attention to trust, explainability, and error states.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously and deliver high-quality work without requiring significant direction.

  • Strong communication skills, written, verbal, and visual, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions to engineers, PMs, and executives alike.

  • A portfolio that showcases deep UX thinking, clear user journeys, and a high degree of visual polish.

Preferred

  • Experience contributing to or maintaining a multi-platform design system, including pattern documentation and component creation.

  • Background in Financial Services, Investment Management, Real Estate, or adjacent industries.

  • A track record of designing complex tables, filters, and data visualization tools.

  • Experience planning and running customer interviews or usability tests.

  • Based in the SF Bay Area to facilitate in-person collaboration with local teams.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $148,000 to $185,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including seniority, skillset, location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

kalshi-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for an outlier Product Designer to help craft the experience of prediction markets through elegant and simple UX and delightful product interactions. You will own the core customer journeys, including how our users discover, research, trade, manage their positions in, and reference prediction markets. Your role will push you to be close to customers and to bring creative solutions to their needs, including the ones they’re not aware of.

If you love creating moments of delight, you deeply care for our craft, and you are excited to bring prediction markets to the world, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Create awe: build delightful product experiences that make our customers go from liking the product to loving it

  • Simplify and distill: promote accessibility to Kalshi and take complicated financial actions and turn them into elegant, simple, and easy to understand product flows

  • Research and talk to customers: refine and improve our understanding of our customers and their needs, including those they’re not aware of

  • Rapidly produce concepts and prototypes: apply an experimental and iterative mindset to design and solution exploration

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product design

  • A compelling portfolio showcasing your ability to craft delightful product experiences (show us!)

  • Deeply in love with your craft, obsessive over design details, and focused on excellence in execution.

  • Strong customer intuition and consumer sensibility

  • Ability to move fast and adjust quickly, in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

  • Passion for prediction markets and/or financial markets

  • Bonus: past experience in consumer fintech or trading

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Base Salary Range: $180,000–$270,000
This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out — we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

kinetic-founding-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
What is PayMe

PayMe helps people find and claim money they are already owed. It sits at the intersection of consumer product, trust, conversion, and financial outcomes.

That makes design unusually important. The product has to feel clear, trustworthy, and worth acting on.

What we need

PayMe needs a founding designer who owns the frontend experience end to end. This person should make the product clearer, tighter, more trustworthy, and more worth paying for.

The center of gravity is design. Taste matters more than raw engineering depth. But this cannot be a pure designer. We want someone who has already crossed into shipping real product work, mostly with modern AI tools.

Who you are

  • Strong consumer app taste

  • Real product thinking

  • Meaningful shipped work, either a large side project or an awesome feature at work

  • Clear explanation of what you designed versus what you built

  • Real interest in moving further into engineering over time

Why it's exciting

  • You will own the frontend experience, not just a slice of it

  • You will work on the highest-leverage parts of the product: onboarding, activation, paywall, and conversion

  • You will have real influence over how PayMe feels and performs

  • You will work on a small team where good ideas ship fast

What you own

  • The frontend product experience end to end

  • The quality bar for key user flows

  • Designing and improving onboarding, activation, paywall, and other conversion-critical surfaces

  • Turning fuzzy product questions into sharp design hypotheses and shipped improvements

  • Using AI and lightweight implementation ability to help move frontend work forward

What success looks like

  • Onboarding gets clearer and tighter

  • Activation improves

  • Paywall and conversion flows improve

  • The app feels more coherent and polished

  • Design stops being a bottleneck

What you're not here to do

  • Be a pure visual designer who hands things off

  • Be a backend or systems engineer

  • Wait for perfect specs before moving

  • Act as project manager for everyone else

Our process

  • 15 min screen with Kinetic's Lead Engineer

  • Half-day async paid project

  • Deep dive with Kinetic's Founding Designer

  • Team conversations, including PayMe's General Manager

  • Internal work day, with a possible second day depending on how it goes

Target turnaround ~2 weeks from start to finish.

lean-in-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Lean In & The Sandberg Bernthal Family Foundation

The Sandberg Goldberg Bernthal Family Foundation (SGBFF) works to build a more equal and resilient world. We bring people together to support each other through four initiatives: LeanIn.Org , LeanInGirls.Org , OptionB.Org , and the Dave Goldberg Scholarship Program.

Through our community, research-based content, and programs, we help women and allies build the skills, confidence, and networks they need to reach their full potential. We believe a more equal world is possible - and that it will take us working together to create it. While the majority of your work will focus on Lean In, this role offers the opportunity to drive impact across multiple mission-driven initiatives.

Role Overview

We're seeking a talented Product Designer to craft intuitive, beautiful, and impactful experiences for our digital products. You'll be instrumental in shaping how millions of women interact with Lean In's platforms, ensuring our products are accessible, engaging, and empowering.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end design process - from research and concept development to prototyping, testing, and final implementation
  • Conduct user research, including interviews, usability testing, and surveys, to deeply understand the needs of our community
  • Translate insights into clear wireframes and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile using Figma
  • Build and evolve design systems and patterns that ensure consistency and scalability across products
  • Organize design files, documentation, and workflows with precision and clarity
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to bring ideas to life
  • Advocate for users while balancing business goals and technical feasibility
  • Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders, incorporating feedback with openness and focus
  • Generate innovative ideas that advance Lean In’s mission and strengthen engagement
  • Stay current on design trends, tools, accessibility standards, and inclusive design best practices

What You Will Bring

  • 4+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating user-centered thinking and strong execution
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout, and design systems
  • Exceptional organization skills and the ability to manage complex design systems and workflows
  • A strong foundation in interaction design, visual design, and information architecture
  • Experience conducting user research and translating insights into actionable solutions
  • A creative mindset grounded in strategy and impact
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and inclusive design principles
  • Experience prototyping and iterating based on testing and feedback
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Experience working in cross-functional, agile teams
  • A genuine commitment to Lean In’s mission to inspire and equip women to lead
  • Alignment with the initiatives of the Sandberg Bernthal Family Foundation, including building resilience and creating social impact

What We Will Offer You

  • Base Salary: $140,000 – $160,000 based on experience, skills, and qualifications
  • Performance Bonus: Up to 15% of base salary annually
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with a 4% employer match
  • Generous paid time off
  • Additional benefits designed to support well-being and long-term success

  • Work Location: We believe in the power of in-person collaboration. This role is based in San Francisco, with a hybrid schedule of three days in office per week (currently Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday) and remote flexibility on other days, beginning September 2026.

The Sandberg Goldberg Bernthal Family Foundation is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard to age, race, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. It’s important to us that people of all identities and backgrounds see themselves represented and included in our work, so we actively encourage people of all identities and experiences to apply.

Before you apply, please review our approach to AI in the hiring process here.

leona-health-lead-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Leona is on a mission to empower everyone to take the best care of themselves, their patients, and their loved ones. We have an ambitious goal: to transform the way the world interacts with healthcare, because where you live shouldn't determine the quality of care you receive.

For patients, managing your health should feel empowering, not intimidating. For doctors, we want to eliminate the administrative noise so you can focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care. We're reimagining what it looks like for doctors to care for patients in an AI-first world — starting with a platform that streamlines doctor-patient communication via WhatsApp, acting as an AI clinical assistant that automates non-urgent tasks, surfaces what's urgent, and gives patients the convenience of reaching their care team 24/7.

With bases in San Francisco and Mexico City, our team brings together years of experience scaling companies like Uber, Rappi, Modern Fertility, and Wonder across the US and Latin America. We're backed by a16z, General Catalyst, and Accel, and a remarkable group of angels including the founders of Nubank, Rappi, and Maven Clinic.

If you're hungry to build 0-to-1, and roll up your sleeves to make magic, thrive in ambiguity, and care deeply about building a better future, this role might be the perfect fit for you.

The Role

Location: San Francisco or Mexico City, but we can be flexible for the right candidate

We seek an experienced product designer to lead the design of a new tool aimed at giving doctors superpowers. If you’re driven by user experience, enjoy the challenge of solving complex design problems with easy-to-use solutions, and are looking to play a critical role in taking a product from 0 to 1, this role is for you.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design of high-end, impactful product experiences for Leona’s digital products

  • Spend time getting to know our target users and develop empathy for their unique needs

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders

  • Be a key decision-maker on a small but talented team

  • Help us make Leona a company that stands out for its design excellence

Requirements:

  • Has a proven track record of designing mobile-first digital products, with at least 7 years of relevant work experience

  • Spanish & English language fluency

  • Specific experience designing for native mobile apps (iOS or Android), with extensive knowledge of common design patterns + guidelines. Has experience designing user experiences for complex native mobile applications, and has extensive knowledge of common design patterns + guidelines

  • Mastery of the various tools needed for each step of the design process

  • Feels comfortable taking ideas from wireframes to pixel-perfect deliverables, and is excited about defining and owning this process

  • Experience working closely with engineers

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • A passion for building

What You Can Expect:

  • Autonomy & Responsibility: You will take ownership of your time and efforts, prioritizing the activities that have the largest impact for the company

  • Team Collaboration: We are very team oriented; you’ll have the opportunity to work with a small, nimble team of superstars, gaining insight into building a company from scratch. Everyone in the team is here to help each other - 24/7.

  • Mentorship: The team members are here to support your career growth goals within the company and afterwards

  • Ambiguity: There are a lot of unknowns given the early stage of the company, you will be responsible for navigating ambiguous environments and determining the best path forward

  • Dedication: If you prefer 9-5 environments, this role is not for you. While there is no strict ‘clocking in/clocking out’ schedule, the aggressive growth goals require the team to work more than 8 hours a day

  • Flexibility & Generous Benefits: Unlimited vacation policy, health insurance, wellness benefits, unique team offsites (past examples include hot air balloon rides, cooking classes, and padel tournaments).

lunon-founding-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
Lunon is the world's first AI-native consulting firm. We run engagements for private equity firms and global enterprises across the full spectrum of consulting work. The work is institutional quality, delivered in a fraction of the time and cost.

We believe the traditional consulting model is fundamentally broken. Firms charge $500 an hour for analysts doing work that AI can do better, faster, and more rigorously. We are building the platform that proves it, and delivering the engagements that demonstrate it.

We have raised a $2M pre-seed round backed by General Catalyst, SV Angel, and top Silicon Valley names, with advisors across the world's leading PE firms and consulting practices.


What you'll own

As Lunon's Founding Design Engineer, your job is to make complex analytical work feel clear, fast, and inevitable. The platform you are building is where hundreds of millions of dollars in deals get analyzed and decided. Engagements are carried out end to end on it, from initial scoping through live AI-driven research and analysis, to polished reports and deliverables that clients access directly on the platform. The clients sitting on the other side expect something that matches the weight of that work, every pixel, every interaction, every data visualization has to be perfect.

You will own the intersection of design and engineering, turning high-stakes financial and strategic data into interfaces that PE partners and executives actually trust. You will build the design system and frontend standards that every future engineer inherits, making every incremental feature easier to ship and more refined to use.


How you'll work

  • Your workflow, your tools, your call. Paper, Framer, Figma, Claude Design, etc. straight into Claude Code or Cursor, whatever gets the best result fastest.

  • You ship it yourself. No handoffs, no waiting.

  • You stay on top of the best tools as they emerge and bring that to the team.

This is not a design role. This is not an engineering role. It's both, and the opportunity to define the visual and interaction language of a category that does not exist yet.


Must haves

You are a good fit for Lunon if you are a formidable design engineer. This means you stop at nothing to accomplish your goal. We don't care much about your current skills or even what you've done before; we care that you will be able to do anything you set your mind to.

You must be pragmatic. Lunon is a startup so something is always on fire. You need to know when to let little fires burn and when to break out the extinguisher.

You must have strong design taste and the engineering skills to bring your ideas to life. You should be equally comfortable prototyping as you are in code. You're obsessed with craft, the micro-interaction that feels off, the visualization that could tell a clearer story, the flow that adds one too many clicks.

You must be empathetic. We're building products for other people, so you need to understand how they think and why. You'll be the voice of the user in every product decision.

You must be an excellent communicator. You are building interfaces that put complex analytical work in front of some of the most demanding professionals in the world. Clarity has to come naturally.

Finally you must be gritty. You pick the hardest, highest-quality option regardless of the effort it takes and you push through it.


Why Lunon

  • Early equity in a category-defining company.

  • Young, hungry founding team. No bureaucracy, no politics, just building.

  • Small team, high trust, no one looking over your shoulder.

  • $2,400 yearly learning and tools stipend.

  • Early model access through an OpenAI partnership.

  • Remote

About the interview

  1. 30-minute intro call with founders

  2. Take-home design and build challenge

  3. 30-minute portfolio review and interview with Dhruv (CEO) and Connor (CTO)

  4. 3-5 day paid work trial

luxury-presence-sr-product-designer-cont.descriptionHtml:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Design Opportunity

Design at Luxury Presence is core to our mission: to empower real estate entrepreneurs with elegant, user-centered tools. We believe great design starts with understanding — of the customer, the problem, and the context. Our best work is driven by curiosity about how people think, what they need, and where their current tools fall short.

We value usability, not as a feature, but as a baseline expectation. Our team obsesses over reducing friction, making workflows intuitive, and solving real pain points with clarity and care.

At the same time, we hold a high bar for visual quality. Designers here know when to polish, when to iterate, and how to use thoughtful craft to earn trust, build delight, and elevate the overall experience. We celebrate simplicity, consistency, and purposeful design.

Whether you’re passionate about UX systems, elegant interfaces, or shaping the quality of a product area, we’ll support you in doing the best design work of your career.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer (contract) to lead product design efforts within one of our core product areas. You’ll own experiences end to end — from framing problems and surfacing user needs to delivering polished, dev-ready designs — in close partnership with product, engineering, and other functions.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving real user problems, can operate independently in a defined space, and wants to grow their influence across craft, collaboration, and product thinking.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design end-to-end user experiences, from early discovery and low-fidelity exploration to detailed, dev-ready execution.

  • Stay deeply connected to user needs through research, interviews, testing, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

  • Translate insights into clear, usable, and delightful solutions — designing for multiple states, edge cases, and accessibility needs.

  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to frame problems and identify the right solutions.

  • Prototype and test concepts quickly using the appropriate fidelity and tools.

  • Contribute to our design system, ensuring patterns are reusable, accessible, and well-documented.

  • Share work early and often: give and receive feedback, participate in critique, and help uplevel team quality.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product design

  • Strong experience designing and shipping digital products in cross-functional teams.

  • A portfolio that highlights user-centered problem solving, strong UX thinking, and high-quality craft.

  • Proficiency in Figma, with comfort in component libraries, prototyping, and design tokens.

  • Clear, confident communication of design decisions, user needs, and tradeoffs.

  • A keen eye for visual and interaction design, with the judgment to know when to polish and when to ship.

  • Curiosity, empathy, and a drive to improve user outcomes through design.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

mastra-founding-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Mastra has a highly capable engineering team, and our pace of development has sometimes meant that design has had to catch up.
Our platform and studio have been designed mostly by our engineering team. They look pretty, but we don’t have a standardized set of interaction patterns, nor have we really ironed out these flows until they shine.
That’s your job.

What you will do

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Mastra framework and platform, including how different features work together and which interaction patterns best support each use case.

  • Watch screen recordings, talk to users, watch recordings, figure out where people are getting stuck and what's confusing for them.

  • Continuously research emerging interaction patterns, developer tools, and best-in-class products to inform your work.

  • Think from the perspective of a developer and identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve the user experience across Mastra Studio and the Mastra Cloud platform.

  • Work closely with the product team to understand the roadmap, clarify requirements, and address the most important user problems.

  • Build and maintain a robust design system in Figma, working closely with the front-end team to ensure consistency across Storybook and the implemented product.

  • Figure out how to simplify the Figma-to-code workflow to accelerate prototyping, and reduce the gap between design and implementation.

About you

  • You have at least four years of experience designing software products. Alternatively, you have a strong track record in an adjacent discipline, such as brand or web design, and have recently transitioned into product and UX design.

  • You have experience building and maintaining design systems. Mastra's design system is lean and lightweight, but it supports many surfaces and needs to evolve quickly.

  • You've worked with developer products before, and you have some understanding of the nuances of agentic products as well.

  • You're able to communicate and collaborate well and iterate quickly in a remote / somewhat async culture. You need to be able to propose and sometimes implement iterative fixes without stopping the world while you're figuring out the answer.

  • You're able to work through a problem until you've figured out all the different things that simultaneously need to be true of the solution, and craft one accordingly.

About Mastra

Mastra is the open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents. Built by the team behind Gatsby, backed by Y Combinator and Spark Capital, with $35M raised total. We went from 0 to 27k+ stars and 1M+ weekly npm downloads in under 18 months.

Small team, shipping fast, fully remote. Most of us work across North American and European time zones.

maven-clinic-design-lead-consumer.descriptionHtml:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the role

We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.

What You'll Do:

  • We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.
  • This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.
  • It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.
  • You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.
  • You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.
  • You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.
  • The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.
  • Experience formally managing or leading design teams.
  • Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.
  • A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.
  • Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.
  • Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.
  • A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.

We’d especially love to see

  • Experience in healthcare, women’s health, telehealth, digital health, insurance, fintech, marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, or another regulated or trust-sensitive domain.
  • Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.
  • Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.

The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C., we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

About The Role:

Maven is building the leading platform in women's and family health. Design is central to how we earn member trust, differentiate in market, and deliver on our clinical mission at scale. We are looking for a VP of Design to lead product design, brand design, and user research — and to help position Maven as a design leader in healthcare.

This is an AI-native role. We expect the person in this seat to use AI to move faster, think bigger, and raise the bar on what a small, high-performing team can produce. That means modernizing how the design org works — from research to production to cross-functional collaboration — and helping the rest of the company understand what's possible when design operates at its best.

This role reports to the Chief Product Officer and sits at the intersection of business strategy, product craft, and brand. You'll lead a team of roughly 15 designers, translate company goals into design priorities, and bring a point of view that influences decisions at the executive level.

We're looking for a leader who is close to the work, relentless about quality, and genuinely energized by the challenge of moving fast without losing craft.

What You'll Do:

  • Translate company goals into clear design priorities — and make sure the team is working on the things that move the needle
  • Drive conversion, member engagement, and clinical outcomes through design, not just aesthetics
  • Be a credible voice in executive forums: able to articulate why a design decision matters in terms of growth, retention, or clinical quality
  • Navigate the complexity of serving two distinct audiences — members seeking care and employer/health plan clients configuring programs — without compromising either

Set the vision and position Maven as a design leader

  • Define a cohesive design vision across consumer and enterprise products, brand, and research
  • Build and champion a design system that creates consistency at speed
  • Establish the standards and culture that make great work repeatable, not accidental
  • Bring a genuine point of view on what world-class healthcare design looks like — and help Maven earn that reputation publicly

Lead product design across Maven's core programs

  • Partner with product and engineering to deliver exceptional experiences across maternity, fertility & family building, parenting & pediatrics, and menopause
  • Lead the design of AI-native product experiences — conversational interfaces, agent-driven workflows, adaptive onboarding — with clarity about what AI enables and where human judgment matters most

Own brand design end to end

  • Lead Maven's visual identity and brand expression across enterprise marketing, consumer product, and clinical communications
  • Partner with go-to-market, clinical, and executive teams to maintain a brand that is distinctive, trustworthy, and mission-aligned
  • Oversee agency partnerships and brand production pipelines

Modernize how the team works

  • Build an AI-native design practice: use AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, production, and quality review — and establish workflows that become a model for the rest of the org
  • Create the conditions to ship faster without sacrificing craft: clear prioritization, strong feedback loops, shared standards, and a culture that celebrates both speed and quality
  • Embed user research as a core input to every decision, not a separate track that runs behind the work

Build and develop the team

  • Lead, grow, and retain a team of product designers and brand designers
  • Create real career paths and give designers the context they need to do their best work
  • Champion accessibility and equity in design practice

What You'll Bring:

  • 10+ years of design experience, including 4+ years leading multidisciplinary design teams in a product-led company
  • A strong portfolio that demonstrates craft across both product design and brand — you have taste, and you can articulate why it matters
  • Proven ability to connect design priorities to business goals — you think in outcomes, not outputs
  • AI-native working style: you use AI tools daily, you've built workflows around them, and you have strong opinions about how they change what a design team can do
  • Experience shipping AI-driven or conversational product experiences, or clear conviction about how to approach them
  • Proven experience building and scaling design systems in complex product environments
  • Experience running user research as a core function, not an afterthought
  • A track record of partnering effectively with Product, Engineering, and Marketing at the executive level
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills — you can present to a CEO and give a designer line-by-line feedback on the same day
  • High standards and low ego: confident in your point of view, collaborative in how you get there
  • Experience in healthcare, benefits, or complex B2B/B2C hybrid businesses is a strong plus
  • Experience building brands in mission-driven or regulated industries is a plus

The base salary range for this role is $250,000 – $350,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).
