stedi-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is building the first new healthcare clearinghouse in decades. In the healthcare sector, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) requires that all insurance payers exchange transactions such as claims, eligibility checks, prior authorizations, and remittances using a standardized EDI format called X12 HIPAA. Clearinghouses process the majority of these transactions, offering consolidated connectivity to carriers and providers. Until Stedi, the space was occupied entirely by a small group of legacy players, built on outdated, often pre-internet technology.

Stedi is the world's only programmable healthcare clearinghouse. By offering modern API interfaces alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

We have lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company’s infrastructure; passion for automation and eliminating toil; $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack’s interview with First Round Capital.

What we’re looking for

Stedi is the world's only programmable healthcare clearinghouse. By offering a modern API interface for running eligibility checks and processing claims, healthcare technology businesses can exchange transactions with payers without dealing with the EDI protocol or carrier-specific connectivity.

As we continue to scale, we are looking for an experienced product designer who can own the look, feel, polish, and implementation of the UI of our new healthcare products. We work in a highly technical space—it’s full of detail, interesting interaction problems, and knotty user experience challenges. If you’re passionate about healthcare and mastering the design of complex systems, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Deliver high-quality design work, from conception to delivery, for various products on the Stedi platform

  • Work collaboratively and build with engineers and our customer team to identify and solve user, product, and business problems

  • Help define strategy — understanding and articulating the product’s goals, success metrics, roadmap, and commitments

  • Design and prototype multiple ideas quickly and connect regularly with customers to validate product directions

  • Improve our internal design system, and push for higher quality across the whole product, not just the screens in front of you.

Who you are

  • 4+ years of product design experience at a product-driven tech company shipping software

  • Healthcare experience required

  • Frontend development experience with React, Next.js and HTML/CSS

  • Experience shipping software that works on complex problems, such as developer tools, revenue-cycle management, fintech systems, process management, or others

  • Have good practical knowledge of end-to-end product design — from user research through high-fidelity design and developer handoff.

  • Comfortable working with engineering, design, and business teams

  • A great juggler of creative optimism and critical investigation

  • Comfortable building iteratively to gather feedback

  • Located in PST - EST time zones.

  • Philosophical alignment with the Stedi Standards.

We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note:

  • All official communication about roles at Stedi will only come from an @stedi.com email address, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.

  • If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to contact us directly at careers@stedi.com.

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

suno-senior-staff-design-engineer-ios.descriptionHtml:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're hiring a Design Engineer to help shape the future of music creation by bringing product experiences to life through both design and code. This is a highly collaborative role sitting at the intersection of Product Design and Engineering, focused on turning ideas into polished, interactive experiences that delight millions of users.

You'll partner closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to prototype, build, and refine user-facing features across our web and mobile platforms. We care deeply about craft, speed, and experimentation, and we're looking for someone who is equally excited about designing interfaces as they are about implementing them.

If you're passionate about creating exceptional consumer products and love working where design and engineering overlap, we'd love to hear from you.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/wocaJrca6E4RjJok

What You'll Do

  • Take ideas end-to-end from conception to production. You drive creation whether it's collaboration in Figma, a novel proof of concept, or the code that turns concept into reality.

  • Strike a balance between proactive ownership and autonomy with a deeply collaborative spirit, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and others.

  • Hold an incredibly high standard for quality and craft. You care about the little details (pixel-perfection, microinteractions, motion design) that add up to excellence.

  • Think in systems and patterns. You’ll help establish our design system to ensure consistency and quality across Product Design and Engineering.

  • Experiment rapidly with AI-powered workflows and creative tools that push the boundaries of what the team can accomplish together.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years (Senior) or 7+ years (Staff) of experience designing and building exceptional consumer products. Your portfolio showcases thoughtful design and shipped product experiences.

  • Mobile UI expertise. You craft delightful interfaces with iOS frameworks like SwiftUI and UIKit, and anything else that helps you design and build best-in-class mobile experiences.

  • A bias for action. You thrive as a self-starter in a fast-paced environment where you can wear many hats and bring your ideas to life.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You’re always learning and growing, and can help bring clarity to a fast-moving problem space with more questions than answers.

  • A love for music (listening, exploring, making) is a huge plus.

Additional Notes

  • This is an in-person role working at our NYC or LA office.

  • Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is $220K – $280K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Perks & Benefits

  • Company Equity Package

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Creative Education Stipend

  • Generous Commuter Allowance

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

supabase-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Product Designer at Supabase, you'll be a key member of our design team, crafting innovative and user-focused solutions for our open-source database platform. You'll collaborate closely with Product Engineers, Product Managers, Product Marketing Managers and other peer designers to take ideas from idea to completion, ensuring a seamless and intuitive user experience across all Supabase products.

Your work will directly impact the developer community, making databases more accessible, powerful, and easy to use. You'll shape how developers experience Supabase at every touchpoint, driving clarity, usability, and craft across the entire product.

You'll have opportunities to lead, propose, and execute projects across various products and tools. Whether simplifying complex workflows, designing new features, improving onboarding, or elevating the overall product experience, your contributions will shape our platform's future.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Aligning teams with working prototypes, user flows, or high-fidelity mockups, choosing the most effective communication method.

  • Anticipating potential pitfalls ahead of time and improving usability to resolve them.

  • Leading complex design challenges, with the ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals.

  • Finding alignment with cross-functional teams, along with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Success Engineers, Sales, Product Engineers, Product Marketing Managers, and other stakeholders.

  • Conducting or applying user research, gathering feedback, and using data to inform and validate design decisions.

  • Contributing to the overall product ecosystem, ensuring consistency and scalability across a growing product surface. You’ll be solving multiple problems at once by creating product primitives that can be reused, extended, and combined in different contexts.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Prototype and show ideas rather than talk about them.

  • Prefer to collaboratively work with others that have different skill sets and possess different points of view.

  • Are actively building things outside of work; side projects, personal experiments; you're curious and you ship.

  • Can move fast without sacrificing craft. You balance quality with speed and know when good enough is good enough

  • Have high standards for design quality and user experience.

  • Can write code (with AI), and should be comfortable designing for a technical audience.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

superhuman-senior-visual-designer-contra.descriptionHtml:

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. We’re looking for a Contract Visual Designer to join the Brand Experience team within the Design Foundations organization to help us deliver on our rebrand expansion and quality expectations in our product. This is a hands-on, full-time engagement for someone who loves the craft of design, and cares deeply about how a color palette lands emotionally and systematically and can move from brief to a polished, production-ready deliverable while maintaining our brand promise and attention to detail.

You’ll be collaborating daily with Brand Experience and Product Design partners, within the Design organization. We’re looking for a creative thinker who can shape ideas and then bring them to life to scale the team.

\nWhat You’ll Do

Job Details

sydecar-staff-ux-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Sydecar is on a mission to transform the world of private markets. Our goal is to make these markets more accessible, transparent, and liquid, and we're achieving this by revolutionizing the way investment vehicles are created and executed.

At Sydecar, we're not just a platform; we're a trusted partner in venture capital. We're dedicated to simplifying and standardizing the private investing experience, empowering capital allocators to discover and support visionary entrepreneurs who are shaping the future.

Our platform is designed with ease and efficiency in mind. We take care of all the behind-the-scenes tasks, from automating banking, ensuring compliance, handling contracts, managing taxes, to streamlining reporting. This leaves investors the freedom to concentrate on what matters most: making valuable deals and nurturing meaningful relationships.

Join us at Sydecar, as we lead the charge in revolutionizing private investing.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Designer to help redefine our product experience as we scale. This is a high-ownership, high-execution role for a designer who moves fast, makes strong decisions, and drives work to completion while maintaining an exceptional bar for craft and customer understanding.

You’ll play a central role in shaping product strategy through deep user research, strong design judgment, and close partnership with Product and Engineering.

Our product operates in a regulated environment, serving a broad range of customers from first-time investors and deal organizers to large venture capital firms. Success in this role requires balancing compliance and regulatory constraints with delivering a best-in-class, intuitive experience for complex financial workflows.

What You’ll Do

Own and Evolve the End-to-End UX

  • Lead the evolution of the entire user experience for deal leads, investors, and internal operations teams

  • Personally drive design on high-impact initiatives, from discovery through delivery

  • Simplify complex, regulated workflows into clear, intuitive experiences that create trust for our customers

  • Set and maintain a high bar for design quality while operating with startup speed

Research-Led Design Leadership

  • Lead user research as a first-class input to product strategy and design decisions

  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define problems, test assumptions, and validate solutions

  • Act as a strong voice of the customer in roadmap and prioritization discussions as well as on specific initiatives

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into clear, actionable direction

Design Systems & UI Foundations

  • Lead the adoption and evolution of design systems, shared UI components, and design libraries

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to ensure consistent implementation across the product

  • Define standards, guidelines, and best practices that enable speed without sacrificing quality

  • Balance systemization with flexibility as the product evolves

Design for Impact in a Regulated Environment

  • Work with SMEs to balance regulatory, compliance, and operational requirements with excellent UX

  • Design systems and flows that support trust, accuracy, and clarity for investors and deal organizers

  • Make confident trade-offs when constrained, and communicate them clearly

  • Use data to inform decisions and optimize for outcomes such as conversion, activation, and retention

Support the Growth of the Design Team

  • Act as a mentor for more junior Product Designers

  • Provide direct feedback and clear creative direction to keep work moving and maintain quality.

  • Foster a culture of trust, collaboration, speed, accountability, and continuous improvement

  • Help designers grow both their craft and product thinking

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of product design experience, including at least 2 years of experience as a lead/senior designer

  • Experience establishing or improving design processes on a team.

  • Exceptionally strong hands-on design skills, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX ownership and redesigns

  • Deep experience leading and applying user research to drive strategy and execution

  • Strong experience designing complex workflows, multi-step processes, or system-heavy products

  • Strong experience in design systems and UI libraries

  • Experience working in regulated markets, especially fintech, capital markets, or private venture strongly preferred.

  • Ability to balance compliance and regulatory needs with delivering a best-in-class customer experience

  • Experience with consumer and/or SMB products strongly preferred

  • Data-informed, outcome-oriented designer with a bias toward execution

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and energized by early-stage environments

Sydecar’s values

Our values are important to the way we live and work at Sydecar. They guide our priorities, behaviors and interactions.

Be Committed

As a team, we rise to meet challenges and recognize that we become stronger and develop character when facing adversity.

Be Excellent

We measure our success not just by what we achieve, but by how we achieve it—through integrity, creativity, elegance, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Excellence is not just doing things well—it's looking for ways to do them better.

Be Humble

Humility is our key to personal and professional growth. We appreciate that great ideas can come from anywhere, regardless of seniority, pedigree, or experience. We care more about collective outcomes than who gets credit or who does what. We try to not let our ego cloud our judgment.

Win Together

Winning is no accident. It is the result of collective hard work, perseverance, sacrifice, and most of all, loving what we do. Winning requires that we give extra—sometimes winning calls for late nights or extra effort, and we show up for clients and each other with urgency and heart. While excellence is a journey, winning is a destination.

Sydecar is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Sydecar are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Sydecar will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Sydecar encourages applicants of all ages.

tandem-health-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Tandem, you'll be instrumental in shaping our user experience. You’ll collaborate closely with our brilliant Product & Engineering team, and company leadership to craft intuitive, elegant, and impactful experiences. The interfaces you design will be the future of how both clinicians and patients interact with the healthcare system.

We’re a fast-moving team, so this role is a great fit if you thrive in ambiguity, can make progress with imperfect information, and is energized by rapid iteration. We work in short cycles: ship, learn, improve. Perfection isn’t the goal - momentum and learning are.

What You will Do

  • Lead end-to-end design work - from research and ideation to execution

  • Conduct user interviews and distill insights into actionable product decisions

  • Partner with engineering to ensure design aligns with technical constraints

  • Share early work regularly (from sketches to prototypes) to gather feedback

  • Collaborate across teams to inform design and product direction

  • Contribute to product strategy while delivering polished interaction and visual design


What You Bring

  • Proven experience designing digital products with a strong user-centered focus

  • Strong visual design skills and a compelling UX/UI portfolio

  • Proficiency in Figma and design systems

  • Experience leading user research and usability testing

  • Comfort working cross-functionally and managing diverse feedback

  • Ability to think strategically while sweating the design details

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving problem spaces

Bonus Points

  • Experience in early-stage startups

  • Experience with software engineering & building functioning prototypes

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview & Portfolio review with one of our Product Designers

  3. Follow up interview with our CTO and Co-Founder

  4. Working Day - Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & company stock options

  • 30 days/year of paid vacation

  • 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives

  • Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

  • Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

  • Mental health support through our partner Mindler

  • Pension program

  • Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

  • An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

  • Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

tava-health-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:

tavus-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tavus is an AI research lab pioneering human computing. We’re building PALs: a new kind of application that closes the gap between people and machines, free from the friction of today’s systems. Our real-time human simulation models let machines see, hear, respond, and even look real—enabling meaningful, face-to-face conversations. PALs combine the emotional intelligence of humans with the reach and reliability of machines, making them capable, trusted agents available 24/7, in every language, on our terms.

Imagine a therapist anyone can afford. A personal trainer that adapts to your schedule. A fleet of medical assistants that can give every patient the attention they need. With Tavus, individuals, enterprises, and developers can all build PALs to connect, understand, and act with empathy at scale.

We’re a Series B company backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, and Scale Venture Partners.

Be part of shaping a future where humans and machines truly understand each other.

The Role

We are seeking a craft-obsessed, systems-minded Product Designer to evolve our product suite and own & grow the Tavus design systems – the components, tokens, and patterns that every surface we build on top of depends on.

This is a Product Design role that demands exceptional VisD skills and experience. We need someone with exceptional eye and hand for typography, color, spacing, and detail, who can bring real motion craft to how our system feels in use. But the design system doesn't exist in a vacuum: It has to hold up under real product and UX problems, across a growing portfolio of products, so strong product design judgment is a must.

This role has a deliberate arc. In the near term, your focus will be the design system: consolidating, architecting, and elevating it into something stable, distinct, and built to scale with us. As that foundation matures, we expect this role to evolve into ownership of a product area, where you'll carry the same craft and judgment forward into shipping product day to day. We're looking for someone genuinely excited by both halves.

You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and leadership in a fast-paced environment to make the system the clear, trusted foundation for how we design and build. Join our small, creative team of designers, engineers, and product enthusiasts dedicated to thoughtfully bridging the human-machine divide. We're doing it right, sweating the details, and we're in it together.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

What You'll Do

  • Architect for scale: Define the token architecture, component structure, and theming model (light, dark, and beyond) that let the system flex across products and surfaces without forking or drifting.

  • Own governance, not just files: Establish the standards, documentation, and contribution model that keep the system coherent as more designers and engineers touch it. Be the clear, decisive voice when tradeoffs get contentious.

  • Partner deeply with engineering: Work hand-in-hand with frontend engineers to ensure the system is implemented faithfully and effectively.

  • Elevate craft everywhere: Bring meticulous visual and interaction craft, including motion and micro-interaction detail, to every component and pattern so the system doesn't just function, it feels intentional and distinctly Tavus. “Good enough” isn’t.

  • Drive adoption: Make the system easier to use than not using it. Build the artifacts, documentation, and relationships that get other designers, engineers, and marketers to reach for the system first.

Who You Are

  • An indefatigable visual designer, with an exceptional, well-trained eye for typography, color, layout, and detail, plus real motion design chops.

  • A genuinely capable product designer, with 6+ years of experience and solid UX judgment. You understand user flows, interaction patterns, and product tradeoffs well enough that your systems hold up with elegance under real product pressure.

  • Experienced building and governing design systems at scale. You can point to a system you've architected and evolved, not just contributed to, with bonus points for work both within an existing component framework as well as from-scratch builds.

  • Original, not just tasteful. We're not looking for someone who can recognize good design when they see it; we're looking for someone who can produce something distinct that hasn't been seen before. If your portfolio could pass for a dozen other SaaS products, this isn't the right fit. We'll ask you to walk us through specific decisions and the reasoning behind them, and the results those decisions yielded.

  • Principled and able to defend it. You’re especially adept at articulating why a decision is correct. You push back on your own instincts as readily as you push back on others'.

  • Decisive in ambiguity: You don't need permission to make a call. When a system decision has no clean answer, you weigh the tradeoffs, make a defensible choice, and move, while staying meticulous about the details within that decision.

  • Technically fluent: You're comfortable working close to code: reviewing implementation, catching and stopping drift between design and build, and speaking the language of the engineers who ship your system.

  • Built for startup pace: You can operate with minimal specs and shifting priorities, protecting the highest quality bar while moving fast.

Benefits & Culture

When you join Tavus, you’re joining a diverse and supportive team. Our work is driven by our people, and our success is shared by all. This position has a flexible work schedule, unlimited PTO, competitive healthcare, and gear stipends, as well as plenty of fun. At the end of the day, we want Tavus to be a place for you to learn, directly drive impact, and work with a team you love.

To learn more about our team culture and benefits, check out our hiring page.

Tavus is growing fast, and we’d like you to grow with us. If you’re excited to get your hands dirty and help make machines more human, drop your resume and we’ll be in touch.

We are not looking for cultural fits, we are looking for culture creators. Diversity is what drives our success – it’s at the core of how we hire, communicate, and work. We are inclusive to all and combine our diverse backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives to build the best experiences for our clients.

teamsnap-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is looking for a Senior Product Designer who will craft experiences that connect parents, coaches and players to make youth sports more fun. You will partner closely with product and engineer partners to drive features from discovery through execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing consistency, ease of use and innovation across TeamSnap consumer experiences.

What You'll Do:

  • Design high-impact, consistent, and intuitive user experiences across platforms, considering market trends, customer feedback, and quantitative data.
  • Conduct user research and leverage insights to define product requirements, using sketches, wireframes, and prototypes to guide the ideation process.
  • Use a data-driven approach to tie design decisions to user research while balancing business goals and technical constraints.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to refine requirements, validate designs, and iterate based on feedback.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, maintaining a sense of urgency while delivering high-quality designs.
  • Shape, improve, and maintain the TeamSnap design system.
  • Partner with marketing designers to ensure brand consistency across all digital products.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 4+ years of experience as a product designer or a similar role, building digital products with increasing responsibility.
  • Degree in design, human-computer interaction (HCI), or equivalent.
  • Experience in web and app development. Bonus points if you have experience with both B2B and B2C software.
  • An online portfolio that demonstrates the ability to turn high-level ideas and vision into a strong and unique UX and creative solutions with the success metrics to prove it.
  • Expertise in using Figma and prototyping tools.
  • Experience working in tight collaboration and influencing product, engineering, and marketing teams, with the ability to synthesize feedback and input from peers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and discuss technical concepts and cost/benefit tradeoffs of different design solutions.

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $145,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

🖥 Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

🎩 Total Rewards

• W e're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

🏆 Working at TeamSnap

tennr-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist (e.g., for sleep apnea), your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often specialists and medical services are overwhelmed with referrals and the painstakingly manual process it takes to qualify your referral prevents them from getting around to it on time, or sometimes at all. Tennr prevents these delays and denials by making sure every referral gets where it needs to go, with the right info, at the right time. Powered by RaeLM™ Tennr reads, extracts, and acts on every piece of patient information so providers can capture more referrals, slash denials, and reduce delays.

Role Description

As an early designer at Tennr, you'll leverage your design expertise to the product that reduces patient delays across the U.S Healthcare System.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is passionate about tackling the most complex challenges in healthcare and isn’t afraid to own them. Someone who skillfully parses through ambiguity and deeply cares about creating the best possible experiences. You’ll report directly to a co-founder to help inform our roadmap and problems to work on.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong ambition to tackle a high-impact problem space, who can thrive in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to contribute to foundational aspects across product, design, and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Take full design ownership across multiple project streams, leading the entire product design process from research to development handoff and post-release analysis and support.
  • Collaborate with the team to prioritize the product roadmap and shape product strategy and direction.
  • Conduct user interviews, validate ideas with customers, define key problems to solve, analyze feedback, distill insights, and iterate on design to ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Create high-fidelity interactive prototypes and ensure smooth development handoff. Manage constraints related to scope and deadlines.
  • Be an active contributor to our Design System.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in the design and development process.

Qualifications

  • You excel at breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into clear, actionable projects.
  • You communicate ideas effectively—from high-level abstraction to pixel-level detail—clearly articulating the trade-offs involved.
  • You have a passion for visual precision and a strong commitment to iterating on your work until it reaches customers at the highest level of quality. Your dedication inspires engineering and product partners to uphold the same standard of excellence.
  • You are self-organized and confident in managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • You are adaptable and thrive in fast-paced, ever-changing environments. You can respond quickly to shifts in direction and know how to manage scope within tight time constraints.
  • You have 5+ years of experience in relevant roles, ideally within startups or high-growth environments.

Why Tennr?

  • Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.
  • Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure
  • Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.
  • Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Chelsea office 4 days/week (preferred)
  • Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

Benefits

  • New, spacious Chelsea office
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options
  • Employer-funded 401(k) match
  • Competitive parental leave

thunkable-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Product Designer at Thunkable, you’ll solve complex problems - spanning the product, engineering and marketing organizations and be responsible for the features and projects you bring to life. You will work closely with our engineering team to define features as well as with our marketing team to support growth efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deeply understand our users and their pain points through customer conversations, user research, interviews, and usability testing.

  • Design intuitive user flows and interaction patterns while contributing to and evolving our design system.

  • Create polished, high-quality interfaces with strong attention to usability, accessibility, visual clarity, and consistency.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to transform sophisticated technical systems into simple and elegant user experiences.

  • Prototype and iterate quickly, balancing speed with craft in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Present and communicate design decisions clearly, connecting user experience choices to broader product strategy and business goals.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, data, and marketing teams to bring ideas from concept to launch.

  • Help improve overall product consistency, interaction quality, and design standards across the platform.



Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in product design, with strong foundations in UX research, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating thoughtful product thinking, polished visual execution, and end-to-end product design work.

  • Expertise with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-stage startup environment.

  • Strong design craft with a passion for building experiences that are both beautiful and highly functional.

  • Ability to think from first principles, simplify complexity, and craft elegant solutions.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly through 0→1 product development, rapid iteration, and experimentation.

  • Strong product intuition and ownership mindset, with the ability to independently drive projects from concept to launch.

  • Technical fluency with the ability to collaborate deeply with engineering teams on AI-native products, developer workflows, or technically sophisticated systems.

  • Familiarity with mobile app ecosystems, mobile-first product design, and responsive UX patterns.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear, concise, conversion-oriented product copy.

  • Familiarity with no-code or low-code development platforms is highly preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using modern AI-powered design and creative tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, AI-assisted prototyping tools, or emerging AI-native design workflows to accelerate ideation, prototyping, content generation, and product iteration.

  • Experience designing AI-native or generative AI products.

  • Familiarity with front-end development, design systems implementation, or close collaboration with engineering teams on highly technical workflows.

  • Experience working on mobile-first products, creator tools, developer platforms, or no-code / low-code products.

tilt-principal-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Agora Intelligence (d.b.a. Tilt)

Agora Intelligence is building the audited methodology layer agents call before touching portfolios. Our product, Tilt, is GitHub for rules-based investment methodologies: an open platform and marketplace where investment strategies are created, tested, audited, and distributed — by humans and AI agents alike. As AI agents begin managing real portfolios, they need a trusted source of verified investment logic before they can act. Tilt is that source.

We operate across two connected surfaces: InvestOS, an open standard that lets any brokerage or platform plug verified methodology into its own AI experience; and Tilt, the reference implementation of InvestOS. Tilt is an agentic harness where investors, portfolio managers, and creators can author, remix, and publish strategies. We're a small, senior team (from BlackRock, Bloomberg, BGI, and Quant Funds) backed by Portage Ventures, Lerer Hippeau, Cumberland Investments (and more), working with major brokerages and financial data providers.

What We're Building

InvestOS — an open standard for rules-based methodologies and its reference implementation.

We believe any idea — a theme, a trend, a thesis — can be turned into an investable view. On Tilt, anyone can express a view as a rules-based basket of assets in seconds, backed by evidence and scored against what actually happens. Whether you're modeling a thematic strategy, tracking an emerging technology, or capturing the public-market footprint of a private company, what used to take an index committee months now takes an API call — 100× faster, at a fraction of the cost. We also transform views found on the open web, into rules-based strategies. This lets us measure the performance of any opinion or prediction about the future. The unit is a tilt: a creator-authored view of the world.

The bigger bet: as AI agents take on more of investing, they'll need an open, trusted standard for how investment views are expressed, verified, and combined. When anyone can generate a strategy in seconds, the strategies aren't the asset. The system that versions, tests, and grades them is. We're building that standard — and the platform where those views are made. We’re also building the learning loops for when views resolve against reality, as measured by markets.

Who We Are

We're a team of ~25 senior-to-principal engineers, designers and AI/ML researchers. More than half the team are former founders. We move fast, challenge assumptions, and believe AI should fundamentally change how financial products are built. We have no management hierarchy and work remotely with 4 one-week hackathons per year. “Full stack” to us means you own a slice of the product, including its roadmap and go-to-market.

The Opportunity

Creating an investable index from a conversation with AI isn't a traditional design problem. Users aren't filling out forms or clicking through dashboards—they're collaborating with an intelligent system to express a thesis, understand how it's constructed, and iterate on it over time.

We're looking for a Principal Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex interaction problems, and wants to define what AI-native investing feels like.

You'll work directly with the founders and engineering team to shape both the product and the company. This isn't a role where you'll be handed requirements. You'll help identify opportunities, influence product direction, and set the standard for design across Tilt.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end design of new product experiences, from early concepts and user journeys through polished interfaces and launch.
  • Partner closely with founders, product, engineering, and research to define what we build—not just how it looks.
  • Design AI-native workflows that make complex financial concepts intuitive and approachable.
  • Rapidly prototype ideas, validate assumptions, and iterate using customer feedback, analytics, and experimentation.
  • Simplify sophisticated workflows into experiences that feel fast, clear, and effortless.
  • Help establish and evolve Tilt's design system while maintaining a high bar for craft and consistency.
  • Raise the quality of product thinking across the company by contributing to product strategy, user research, and design reviews.
  • Use AI throughout your design process to explore concepts, accelerate iteration, and improve execution.

Who You Are

  • You have significant experience designing and shipping digital products with measurable customer impact.
  • You're an exceptional systems thinker who can move comfortably between product strategy and interface design.
  • You enjoy turning ambiguous problems into elegant, intuitive experiences.
  • You have a strong foundation in interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and prototyping.
  • You're comfortable presenting ideas, challenging assumptions, and defending design decisions with evidence.
  • You collaborate exceptionally well with engineers and enjoy working through technical constraints together.
  • You care deeply about craft but know when speed matters more than perfection.
  • You're excited about AI and actively use it to improve your workflow.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience designing AI-native products or developer tools.
  • Experience in fintech, investing, enterprise software, or other technically sophisticated products.
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.
  • Experience working at an early-stage startup where you've helped define the product—not just design it.
  • You've built or significantly contributed to a scalable design system.
  • You're naturally curious and enjoy learning new domains, technologies, and ways of working.

What We Offer

  • Direct partnership with the founders and a team where more than half are former founders.
  • Very competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
  • A remote-first, flexible work environment.
  • The opportunity to help define the company creating a new category in capital markets.

How to Apply

Apply through Bookface and include:

  • A link to your portfolio.
  • A short note about a product you've designed that you're most proud of, including the problem you solved and your role in the outcome.
  • A few sentences on why you're interested in Tilt.

tomo-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Tomo is building this generation's most important consumer AI product.

We have been working quietly on a SOTA personal agent that learns what real people care about and empowers them to lead better lives.

Now, we’re using their context to build a living, breathing operating system unique to each user, dynamically generating interfaces in real-time to further empower them to live life with greater agency.

The early results has been phenomenal, with world-class retention and engagement metrics. We've improved thousands of active paying users' lives, even saving a few of them.

tremendous-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

Design at Tremendous

We design experiences that make complex systems feel straightforward and intuitive by taking our time to get things right. We favor depth and scale over speed, while raising the bar for quality so our product stays ahead of the competition. We’re a place for designers who care about doing things well.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for one of our product areas. You'll join a small team of product designers led by our Director of Product Design, and you'll be embedded in a squad with a product manager and several engineers.

Half of our product is used by recipients who never chose us, so the experience has to be self-evident. The other half is a powerful dashboard and API used by everyone from mom-and-pop shops to Google. With one designer per squad, you'll have direct ownership of the experiences you ship.

What you'll do

  • Craft rational, elegant, and intuitive interfaces. We care about implementation ease as much as we care about pixel-perfection.

  • Own the content. Designers at Tremendous own the product copy in their designs.

  • Strategic influence. Contribute to the team’s vision, planning, and roadmap.

  • Contribute to our design system. Consistency is a big part of usability, especially for a financial platform. We aim to leave the system better than we found it.

  • Document heavily. We're an async, international team. Your Notion docs and Figma files should give anyone clear context, constraints, and options without a meeting.

  • Use AI throughout your workflow. Research, prototyping, and iteration. We expect designers to prototype with AI tools and bring working artifacts to the team.

  • Help raise the bar. Push forward and maintain a high design bar and level of execution.

  • Design for a diverse set of recipients, with accessibility and internationalization in mind.

  • Collaborative design. Work closely with PMs, Engineers, and others.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of product design experience.

  • Experience at a startup or fast-moving product company.

  • A portfolio demonstrating functional, simple, and delightful user interfaces.

  • Proven experience building and improving design systems.

  • Excellent written communication and copywriting skills.

  • Experience using AI tools in your design workflow, including prototyping (v0, Claude, Cursor, or similar).

  • The ability to handle ambiguity. You're comfortable conducting research and gathering information to make informed decisions on your own.

What's cool about the role

  • Ship work you’ll be proud of.

  • Own design for a product area, end-to-end. You'll help scope, drive, and measure your work, pushing forward user and business goals.

  • Become the champion for your users. You'll conduct research and usability tests to gain a deep understanding of problems before designing solutions.

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $200,000 - $265,000

  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

true-link-financial-principal-product-de.descriptionHtml:
We are a profitable, mission-driven fintech company building financial solutions for people whose needs go unmet by traditional institutions – people with disabilities, older adults, and people in recovery, and the families and professionals who care for them. We get to wake up every day knowing our work has a profound impact on our customers’ lives, and we run the business with the discipline to keep doing it for the long haul. That track record has earned us a spot on the Forbes Fintech 50 and the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing companies for the last two years.

Design plays an important strategic role at True Link. We're looking for a Principal Product Designer to join our lean and senior product team as a senior individual contributor. Someone who can operate with a high degree of independence, lead customer insight and research initiatives, and own design quality across two of our core business lines. You’ll act as a design consultant, identifying and advocating for high impact areas per the company OKRs, and for strategic focus to bring customer insights to the table and improve the user experience, in addition to supporting in-flight product initiatives.

You'll work day-to-day with our product managers and engineering leads, reporting to the Head of Design. With you, it will be a design team of two; so high autonomy, but still someone to collaborate with. This isn't a role where you'll wait to be handed a brief - you'll be expected to identify what questions need answering, go get the answers, and translate insight into design decisions that move the product forward.

Our users are wonderfully complex and our products solve real, meaningful problems. We are proud to serve family caregivers, professional fiduciaries, trust administrators, people in recovery, and the people who love and support them.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end product design for our Card Platform. From mobile UX iterations of our core product, to iterations of new products as we expand into adjacent categories, to experimental product led growth and AI-powered features like receipt management.

  • Support the design needs of our Trust & Invest business, including micro-iterations on the product, and solving for customer requests.

  • Drive customer insight and research. Identify the open questions that matter; proactively run customer interviews, usability tests, and concept testing; and synthesize findings into clear design implications for both near-term decisions and longer-horizon roadmap thinking.

  • Be the team's strongest advocate for the user perspective in cross-functional discussions, deepening understanding of our customers across the company.

  • Operate as a senior design thought-partner for product and engineering leadership to shape requirements, not just respond to them, which includes navigating stakeholder feedback and applying good judgment about customer discovery versus forward momentum.

  • Represent design in client-facing settings where needed.

  • Produce polished, well-considered design work using our existing design patterns - we're not looking for someone who wants to rethink the foundations. Maintain design coherence across a product suite that serves multiple user types with meaningfully different needs.

  • Handle the full range of design needs: big new features, incremental iterations, mobile polish, and the occasional slide deck or screenshot pull for the sales team.

Who You Are

  • An experienced product design leader with 8+ years of product design experience, especially in lean team environments. Experience in fintech, financial services, or a regulated product environment is a plus.

  • Lead with the user. Research and insight generation is something you proactively do, not something you wait to be assigned to you.

  • Stellar end-to-end design chops, from early discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design and QA.

  • You love being an individual contributor and want to stay close to the work. This includes generating insight, making design decisions, collaborating with teammates, and executing on those decisions.

  • Experience designing for complex, multi-user-type products where different audiences have meaningfully different contexts and needs. Experience designing for caregivers, older adults, or people with complex needs is a plus.

  • High collaboration instinct. You know how to work with product managers, engineers, and non-design stakeholders without losing design integrity.

  • Excellent judgment about process. You know when to go deep and when to move fast, and you can explain why.

  • Comfortable presenting design decisions and rationale to senior stakeholders, including to external partners.

  • Grounded in existing patterns and best practices, and you are not looking to reinvent the wheel, but always looking to make it roll better.

  • Aligned with our values: humility, ambition, caring, excellence, inclusion, and a genuine belief that the work matters.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered product features and the UX considerations that come with them is a plus.

Why You’ll Love Us

  • We operate with the pace of a startup, the rigor of a financial services firm, and the mission-orientation of a company that deeply cares about the people it serves.

  • With fifty million Americans in our addressable market, we are building for the millions of people who need our products and services across the country - and we’ve got the potential to reach many more.

  • We have the privilege of providing financial protection for vulnerable members of society and partnering with expert service providers to do so. Our customers and partners love us, and we love them back. You can sleep soundly every night knowing you are doing a great thing by getting our services into more hands.

  • We treat one another like we treat our customers: with respect and dignity. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are cultural values we take very seriously, and we welcome and recruit team members of all backgrounds and identities.

  • We offer competitive wages, health, dental & vision coverage, paid parental leave, 12 paid holidays each year, your own professional development budget, and generous vacation.

  • The majority of us work from home from all across the US, and we enjoy connecting virtually for laughs with teammates and meeting up in-person: we have small offices in SF and in Kingston NY, and we plan team get-togethers around the country.

If you are a high-performing person who wants to join a diverse, inclusive team and use your skills to make a real impact in people’s lives, we invite you to apply to join our team.

usul-product-designer.descriptionHtml:

Usul is a Silicon Valley AI lab helping America and its allies buy technology at the speed of Amazon Prime. We're Stanford dropouts, MIT AI scientists, and Tier-1 Special Forces Operators dedicating our lives to rebuilding the infrastructure that equips the Western world.


We're the youngest founders to ever win a US Defense contract. Over the past year, we've helped Global 500 companies including RTX, BAE Systems, Palantir, and Ukrainian drone manufacturers win $12B in contracts across 30 NATO nations.

About the Role:

As a Product Designer for Usul, you'll design for our commercial platform, helping the biggest defense companies in the world and frontier startups win government contracts across our allies, as well as for the GUIs and workflows that government operators use daily to acquire technology at high speed. Partnering closely with the Head of Product Design, you'll cross-collaborate with engineers and operational stakeholders to take features from discovery to delivery, while adhering to a consistent, scalable, and intuitive experience across the Usul platform.

We're looking for someone excited to build a new category of product for an audience where Excel is considered "cutting edge." You can work autonomously across multiple domains, from initial research to high-fidelity delivery, and you're able to balance execution speed with deep user empathy. You're user-obsessed, inquisitive, and thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, 5 days a week in-office.

Travel Required:

Who we’re looking for:

  • Experience leveraging AI tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, etc.

  • Can translate raw user feedback into product experiences same day

  • Willing to rethink from first principles and build a net new category defining product

Responsibilities:

vapi-product-designer-ai-ux.descriptionHtml:
Voice AI that resolves, not transfers.

Most phone systems trap callers in menus and scripts. Vapi is the platform for deploying voice agents that know your business and can listen, adapt, and resolve in minutes.

  • The numbers: 1 billion calls. 1 million developers. 10x enterprise ARR growth

  • The customers: Amazon Ring, ServiceTitan, New York Life, Intuit, Kavak, and thousands more, from YC startups to the Fortune 500

  • The news: a $50M Series B led by Peak XV Partners, with Bessemer Venture Partners, Kleiner Perkins, M12 (Microsoft's Venture Fund), Y Combinator, and our earlier backers. Total raised: $72M

Product Designer — AI UX / Product Experience

Location: SF (hybrid Tuesday-Thursday)

About Vapi (/ˈVɑːpi/):
We're creating the shift to voice as humanity's default interface.
We're the most configurable platform for deploying voice agents.
We've grown to over 1M developers, adding thousands every day.
Try talking to Vapi now!

Why We're Hiring This Role

We're building the next generation of AI product experiences and need someone who shapes product direction, not just executes on it. We want a designer who can help us see problems in new ways, raise the quality of our thinking, and create clear, high-leverage product experiences in a fast-moving AI environment.

What You'll Do

30 Day:
Go deep on our complex, technical workflows. Understand the product surface end to end and how customers actually use it.

60 Day:
Own an ambiguous problem area outright. Partner closely with engineering and product to turn it into a clear direction, and ship high-quality work quickly and iteratively.

90 Day:
Contribute novel ideas and patterns that help define how AI-native workflows should work in practice. Be a voice that raises the level of the team, not just execution capacity.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years experience: Exceptional candidates with less considered case by case

  • Exceptional taste: You bring product and design judgment, not just solid execution; strong fundamentals and a modern design sensibility

  • AI-Forward: You design with and around AI-augmented workflows, not just for AI products

  • A rigorous thinker: You frame ambiguous problems clearly and ask sharp questions before jumping to solutions

  • A systems thinker: With range, not at the expense of creativity and product insight

  • B2B / enterprise background: You've designed for enterprise or B2B products, not legacy enterprise software (think Linear or Vercel, not Salesforce, Workday, or Microsoft)
